sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head red-yellow to red-brown, rather short; sides and posterior margin rounded; sides with a slight concavity behind the antennal bases. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 2 equal to segment 4. Labrum with two pointed tips and a median lobe apically, the sides slightly curved. Mandibles slender and elongate, slightly incurved; right mandible with a sharp incision near the base; left mandible with a smooth inner margin. Anterior margin of pronotum very weakly concave. Head length including mandibles 3.45 mm; head width 1.63—1.73 mm; antennal length 2.30 mm; pronotum length 0.33 mm, width 0.78—0.84 mm; hind tibia length 1.35 mm; left mandible length 1.70—1.73 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Antennae 14-segmented; head width 1.10 mm; hind tibia length 1.05 mm.

note: Adapted from the species-level description in Emerson (1928), original in English; the original title is Mirotermes (Basidentitermes) malelaensis, new species, and Basidentitermes is now a genus; the soldier and worker are recorded; the comparison with M. potens, M. mactus, M. aurivillii and M. diversifrons is not translated; figure numbers, localities and collection records are not translated. The OCR misreads "Right mandibles", understood here as the singular right mandible.
